name: AYUSH
description: Formulation of Indian Standards in the field of Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa and Homoeopathy, including raw materials, finished herbal products, processing methods, and clinical equipment.

name: Chemical
description: Standardization in the field of chemicals, chemical engineering, industrial chemicals, fertilizers, pesticides, paints, pigments, detergents, cosmetics, plastics, rubber, laboratory reagents, and treated chemical products.

name: Civil Engineering
description: Standardization in the field of civil engineering including building construction materials, cement, concrete, structural steel, timber, pipes, sanitary fittings, doors, windows, waterproofing, foundation engineering, and National Building Code.

name: Electronics and Information Technology
description: Standardization in the field of electronics, telecommunications, IT, computer hardware, displays, peripherals, audio/video equipment, semiconductors, optical electronics, IoT, AI, cybersecurity, and smart manufacturing.

name: Electrotechnical
description: Standardization in the field of electrical power generation, transmission, distribution, electrical machinery, transformers, cables, switchgear, protection devices, household electrical appliances, solar PV, batteries, and earthing.

name: Environment and Ecology
description: Standardization in environmental protection, environmental monitoring, pollution control equipment, air and water quality sampling, eco-labelling (ECO Mark), solid and electronic waste management, and greenhouse gas accounting.

name: Food and Agriculture
description: Standardization in agricultural machinery, tractors, food processing, grains, cereals, pulses, dairy products, edible oils, spices, food additives, packaging materials for food, animal feed, and post-harvest technology.

name: Management and Systems
description: Standardization in management systems including Quality Management (IS/ISO 9001), Environmental Management (IS/ISO 14001), Occupational Health & Safety (IS/ISO 45001), Energy Management (IS/ISO 50001), Information Security, and Social Responsibility.

name: Mechanical Engineering
description: Standardization in industrial machinery, pumps, compressors, valves, cranes, hoisting equipment, pressure vessels, boilers, refrigeration, air conditioning, bearings, internal combustion engines, and mechanical engineering plant.

name: Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning
description: Standardization in surgical instruments, medical devices, diagnostic equipment, electro-medical equipment, patient monitoring devices, hospital furniture, implants, prosthetics, syringes, surgical gloves, and healthcare infrastructure.

name: Metallurgical Engineering
description: Standardization in ferrous and non-ferrous metals, steel rebars, structural steels, pig iron, cast iron, copper, aluminium, zinc, lead, alloys, metal sheets, pipes, welding consumables, foundry products, and heat treatment.

name: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products
description: Standardization in petroleum fuels (petrol, diesel, aviation turbine fuel), lubricants, greases, LPG, CNG, natural gas, coal, coke, petrochemical products, synthetic rubber, polymers, cosmetics, toys, and sports equipment.

name: Production and General Engineering
description: Standardization in machine tools, manufacturing equipment, industrial cutting tools, hand tools, abrasives, engineering metrology, dimensional gauging, fasteners (bolts, nuts, screws), robotics, automation, and general workshop equipment.

name: Service Sector
description: Standardization in services including banking, financial services, education, tourism, hospitality, healthcare services, logistics, transport services, e-commerce, customer care, and IT-enabled services.

name: Textiles
description: Standardization in natural fibres (cotton, jute, wool, silk), synthetic fibres, yarn, fabrics, garments, technical textiles, geotextiles, medical textiles, protective clothing, industrial filter fabrics, and textile machinery.

name: Transport Engineering
description: Standardization in road vehicles, automotive components, two-wheelers, passenger cars, commercial vehicles, tyres, tubes, braking systems, safety helmets, automotive lighting, electric vehicles, railway rolling stock, signalling, and maritime transport.

name: Water Resources
description: Standardization in water resource development, irrigation equipment, canal structures, dam instrumentation, water distribution systems, flow measurement, hydrology, groundwater recharge, water storage tanks, and flood management.
